notes.title: City of Gangsters Developer Update #3
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s great to be back and exploring more gameplay features! We’ve had a lot of people asking about a [b]playable demo[/b] and can confirm that there will be some news coming on that next [b]Tuesday, June 1[/b] -  so stay tuned.

[u][b]Dealing with troublemakers[/b][/u]

Today we’re going to be shining the spotlight on [b]troublemakers[/b], a type of NPC that you will encounter frequently during your campaign. These are [i]not[/i] rival gangs - we’ll cover those another time. Instead, troublemakers are small-time operators who can be found all over the city, but they only occupy [b]a single corner of territory [/b]and operate independently from larger criminal outfits. You’ll find that they will create both problems and opportunities for your crew, and they come in two types, each with differing priorities:

[b]Interested in brawling - [/b]They roam around and attack other troublemakers, rival outfits and even your crew members. If you get them on your side, they could [b]take care of people[/b] you don’t like, while you keep your hands clean.

[b]Interested in business - [/b]These ones mostly keep to their corner, making them reliable and easy to contact. If you get them on your side, the next time [b]something falls off the back of a truck[/b] in their territory, they might cut you in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/22aaf7c491a5f34f9a2a1add7f2f551e07603a5f.png[/img]

[u][b]Problems they’ll cause[/b][/u]

[b]Burglary and harassment -[/b] Troublemakers sometimes enjoy harassing nearby NPCs, who will then become too afraid to do business with your outfit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/2cae3fa5733b7f1d6c5c091e3f3242569d18f42c.png[/img]

[b]Business locking - [/b]Any businesses located within their corner of territory will be hesitant to work with you until they know that the local troublemaker won’t cause them any problems.

[b]Territory control -[/b] If one of your crew members ends their turn inside a troublemaker’s territory, they might get angry with your outfit. While a troublemaker is angry, they’ll target any of your crew who stray too close to their corner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/c230d568af3d153d34a776b49e9cf91066578306.png[/img]

[u][b]Opportunities they create[/b][/u]

[b]Favors -[/b] As with everyone in [i][b]City of Gangsters[/b][/i] you can influence your relationship level with troublemakers and accumulate favors. Your mutual connections allow you to gain introductions and relationship boosts with troublemakers and vice versa.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/012913ae52439437e9218ac87b82f75e067d6dba.png[/img]

[b]Tip-offs (Business troublemakers) -[/b] Once you’ve built up a positive relationship with this type of troublemaker you’ll receive occasional tip offs about lucrative business opportunities. You pay cash up front, and receive large quantities of legal or illegal resources once they’re delivered. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/0fd3c4b3c9de6786e05fea6e4daeac040c42790d.png[/img]

[b]Target rival outfits (Brawling troublemakers) -[/b] Once you’ve built up a positive relationship with this type, you can send them to attack your rivals, in a way that won’t get connected back to you and affect your relationships.

[u][b]Navigating troublemakers[/b][/u]

If you’re finding that a troublemaker is harassing a key business partner or blocking the expansion of your territory, you have a few options:

[b]Coercion - [/b]Threats can be used to intimate troublemakers into ending their harassment of local businesses. You can even patronize businesses on their corner directly! 

[b]Violence -[/b] If words don’t work, violence will, just don’t expect the police to turn a blind eye when a body shows up on the sidewalk. Also, news of your actions will spread, and depending on how well-connected they were, this might impact your relationships with other people. 

[b]Employment - [/b]If you’ve got a good relationship and have room for a new crew member in your outfit, you can hire troublemakers. They might have some useful, exploitable traits.

[b]Money -[/b] With enough cash you can pay off troublemakers. What they do with the cash you give them, well, that’s not your concern anymore.

We hope you enjoyed learning about these less than reputable characters who inhabit the great urban sprawls in [i][b]City of Gangsters[/b][/i]. Remember to keep a look out for the news coming next week, and until then feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/CityofGangsters]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/CityOfGangsters]Twitter[/url]. 

Matt & Rob
Co-founders - SomaSim

notes.title: City of Gangsters Developer Update #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we’re back with another developer update. Today we’re going to focus on the [b]relationships[/b] that you will be building with the [b]businesses [/b]within your growing network of contacts. We’ll also be sharing progress on the game’s second city map, [b]Pittsburgh[/b]!

[u][b]Business relationships[/b][/u]

Social currency is a big deal in [i][b]City of Gangsters[/b][/i] and effectively managing the relationships with individual businesses will be a key part of spreading your influence across the city.    

Your relationship with each NPC business is the sum total of the interactions you had with that person - your various positive or negative actions towards them, the history of your business deals together, but also the gossip they overheard about what you’ve done to other people. On top of that, personal traits and your crew’s experience will modulate the relationship further. You can see how that is displayed in the UI, in the screenshot below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/4ef0e01436a6c496d75ed7ebecc100044ca0aebc.png[/img]

So what are the advantages of a positive relationship and the disadvantages of a negative one?

This is the time of Prohibition, and booze is illegal, so in order to get anything done, you have to be trusted by the people you’re dealing with. You have to build and maintain a positive relationship.

But when you meet a new business for the first time, your relationship will start around 0 (neutral). At this stage you have very few options - they don’t trust you enough to participate in any illegal deals just yet. However, if you can get them to warm up to you, whether through mutual friends or by showing that you’re on the level, you’ll start to see a much more diverse array of options.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/6893028c1cafab767e09e8aa1d71f79e20b909d2.png[/img]

[u][b]Benefits of a positive relationship[/b][/u]

[b]Gain favors -[/b] Favors are an invaluable resource that can be spent in a wide variety of ways to open up new social and business opportunities for your outfit, e.g. learning about a special event or getting a trusted introduction to someone new.

[b]Open up illegal trade -[/b] Unlock access to a wider pool of tradable resources with the business. This is how you’ll be able to start selling the alcohol that you produce.

[b]Set up a front -[/b] Fronts are the catalysts for territory expansion and will collect protection money from local businesses. NPCs who run fronts for your outfit will often be your strongest allies. 

[b]Set up exclusive trade deals -[/b] Prevent rival outfits from trading with the business for a set number of turns. Just don’t be surprised when rivals will try to do the same to you.

[b]Learn new crew skills -[/b] Improve your outfit’s knowledge which will unlock entirely new production chains and opportunities.

[b]Learn about new properties -[/b] Expand your operational capacity by purchasing new businesses and starting new production locations, bootlegging operations, speakeasies, and so on.

[u][b]Disadvantages of a negative relationship [/b][/u]

[b]Refusal to do business -[/b] If the business owner dislikes and distrusts you, they will refuse to deal with you. So if you have only one supplier of a key resource, it’s crucial to keep them on your side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/0e87f7aaf5392b1490c991ef8e866e1945af90d1.png[/img]

[b]Reputation damage among friends and family - [/b]People will talk to their friends and family about their interactions with you. Whether your actions were altruistic or ruthless, you can be sure that the news will spread. So you’ll need to be careful who you upset, because they might have bigger friends who could give you real problems! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/51594070cd2163ee431bcb2d137c1b55f1e95607.png[/img]

So which actions impact the relationship level?

[u][b]Positive actions[/b][/u]

[b]Doing legal and illegal business -[/b] Buying and selling with an NPC will create a small positive impression. But trading in illegal goods will boost the relationship much higher.

[b]Offer good deals on tradeable resources -[/b] Offering % discounts is a show of good faith which will be appreciated. 

[b]Completing missions -[/b] Depending on the context of your existing relationship, some NPC businesses will ask if you could help them out in various ways, and they will warm up to you considerably and show their gratitude if you succeed.

[b]Getting a trusted recommendation -[/b] Favors accumulated with other people can be redeemed to gain trusted introductions to new contacts, or improve relationships with existing mutual friends.

[b]Defending your people -[/b] Whether it’s helping a local business that’s being harassed by hooligans, or helping out the poor and needy in the community, small acts of benevolence can have a very positive impact.

[b]Helping a mutual friend -[/b] Remember, people talk, and the news of your good deeds is sure to spread.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/ac8ca953d448b65ad7717e84f79bee932e49d2df.png[/img]

[u][b]Negative actions [/b][/u]

[b]Demanding higher prices on tradeable resources -[/b] Adding % premiums on resources that you trade will annoy the business. 

[b]Extortion -[/b] Demanding protection money from businesses within your territory will damage your relationship with them over time.  

[b]Destroying property -[/b] Some businesses will resist extortion but can be coerced into complying by trashing their place in various creative ways. This aggressive action will make them fear and loathe you in equal measure.

[b]Physical harm -[/b] This goes without saying, but people will remember any physical violence you do against them. The more serious the harm, the worse the effect.

[b]Hurting somebody’s friends and family -[/b] If you hurt someone’s brother or extort their cousin, that news will spread and affect your reputation. So be careful when you throw your weight around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/540fadc56684e5bca75b5adbbf3a0779ef8bb0a3.png[/img]

In future posts we’ll look at character traits and how relationships work with the police, local troublemakers and rival gangs, but for now, we hope that this has given you an insight into the fundamental social aspects of the game’s design.

[u][b]Update: Pittsburgh map visuals and unique resources [/b][/u]

With [i][b]City of Gangsters[/b][/i] we wanted to make a game that would have a high degree of replayability and from day one we planned to include [b]three city maps[/b] that would each present a different experience. If you’ve been keeping up with coverage of the game so far you will be familiar with the [b]Chicago[/b] map, which represents the core game. We’ve now turned our attention to the second of these maps, [b]Pittsburgh[/b], adding unique 3D models with architecture specific to that city, such as the colorful houses below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/1070b129483d17f75f0cbc6e8f37b0e57640dd3d.png[/img]

The map also contains new resources linked to the production of two alcohol recipes that are unique to the city, [b]Applejack[/b] and [b]Rakija[/b].   

[b]Applejack (Apple juice + small bottles + ice) -[/b] [i]Jacking is an old technique that uses cold temperatures induced by ice or snow or other cold temperatures to extract alcohol. It takes longer than distillation, but is considerably easier and cheaper. And not at all prone to explode.[/i]

[b]Rakija (Plums + small bottles + sugar) -[/b] [i]Immigrants from certain parts of Europe are sure to appreciate and pay handsomely for a potent taste of home, made from distilled plum juice. [/i]

Thanks again for stopping by and as always, come say hi on [url=https://discord.com/invite/CityofGangsters]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/CityOfGangsters]Twitter[/url] for all the latest news and updates.

Matt & Rob
Co-founders - SomaSim

notes.title: City of Gangsters Developer Update #1
notes.content:
Hey everybody and welcome to the first of our developer updates! From now until launch we will be sharing more frequent updates with you on the progress of [i][b]City of Gangsters[/b][/i]. In these posts we’ll be getting into some of the game’s core mechanics as well as sharing recently added content which we hope you’ll enjoy. 

[u][b]The foundations of an empire.[/b][/u]

Today we’re going to talk a little bit about the foundations of your empire, and the kinds of basic alcohol that you’re going to be producing in the early parts of the game. [b]Homemade Booze[/b] is the lowest hanging fruit and is cheap and easy to manufacture. These are beverages that would have been commonly seen during Prohibition. In [i][b]City of Gangsters[/b][/i] each of our city maps will have its own unique variants of alcohol resources. For now let’s focus on Chicago where [b]Homemade Booze[/b] comes in four flavors: Homemade beer, Hard Cider, Brick Wine, and Moonshine. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/a13691f99adb43815a0b6e781d1a81bd37df0273.png[/img]

Each of these can be produced at a business you control by installing the relevant back-room operation. You’ll notice that all four types of alcohol consist of a base ingredient (neutral alcohol, malt syrup, grape concentrate, apple juice) and a container (stoneware crocks).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/48eeb024ca3d4326274b82de6a5df310491d4b12.png[/img]

Now while crocks are abundant throughout the city, other ingredients can be a little harder to come by. Over time you’ll acquire the skills and knowhow to build your own presses, processers, and distilleries to refine these ingredients. But should you ever find yourself with a short-term supply issue you can bet that someone you know will be happy to help out (with a few greenbacks on the side to sweeten the deal of course!).   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/87b99e2c753c0cacd0fbd54f1d8a36e4d99234f8.png[/img]

Aside from the different ingredients required to make them, the market value of each type of[b] Homemade Booze[/b] varies as well: 

Homemade beer - $8 per crock
Hard cider - $12 per crock
Brick wine - $15 per crock
Moonshine - $20 per crock

You’ll see that Moonshine is considerably more lucrative than homemade beer, but like many aspects of [i][b]City of Gangsters[/b][/i], the locations and level of demand from businesses for a particular resource is entirely procedurally generated, so each new game will present its own challenges and opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/d1b207c407ccc6c86f1ff96e2f74608f93bc6ac8.png[/img]

Depending on the situation then, it might not necessarily be the best strategy to pursue the production of a higher value resource immediately. Instead, your best bet will be to look at the situation, work your connections, and adapt as events unfold…. 

[u][b]Updates: City Districts and new 3D models. [/b][/u]

We’ve recently added city districts to our city maps. Certain buildings and landmarks will be attached to certain districts to give you a better sense of the geography of the city that you are playing in.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/a647da19a302fe6f2c55963f60a603d5632678de.png[/img]

Our 3D artist has also been hard at work on additional models to inject more character into the game world. We’re personally huge fans of the civic buildings (there are a few of this style still standing in Chicago if you know where to look!). Certain buildings will grant outfits that capture them special privileges, the details of which we will share with you later down the line… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/10b5aa8244810801f86fc27117095ddadea33ecc.png[/img]

That’s all for now, but we’ll be back with another update in a few weeks. In the meantime come hang out with us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/CityofGangsters]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/CityOfGangsters]Twitter[/url]. 

Matt & Rob
Co-founders - SomaSim

notes.title: Welcome to City of Gangsters!
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome to [i]City of Gangsters[/i]![/h3]

Let’s go in the back room & talk shop.

[i]City of Gangsters[/i] is a mafia management tycoon game coming exclusively to PCs in 2021, set during Prohibition in Chicago & other US cities. 

It's being developed by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/423580/Project_Highrise/]Project Highrise[/url] developers [url=https://twitter.com/somasim_games]Somasim Games [/url]& published by UK-based indie game publishers [url=https://www.kasedogames.com/]Kasedo Games.[/url]

It's currently in the late alpha stage but you can already wishlist it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386780/City_of_Gangsters/]here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/8080995be7e8a6e965bd9ff624fbb4ebecd1ba67.png[/img]

[i]But what can I do in the game, exactly?[/i]

- Start a crime syndicate from nothing, & grow it into a well-oiled money machine.
- Build speakeasies & illegal distilleries.
- Manage production chains, resource distribution & so much more!

You can read more about the game in Somasim's latest blog post [url=http://www.somasim.com/blog/2020/08/announcing-city-of-gangsters/]here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/0a7bf3379423022314f4cbdb3152b52b4608be1e.png[/img]

But that's not all!

Our game burst on the Gamescom scene last week with: 

- An exclusive [url=https://www.gamestar.de/artikel/city-of-gangsters-staerken-schwaechen,3361313.html?utm_source=dlvr.it&utm_medium=twitter]"first look"[/url] article written & published by German publication GameStar.
- Our [url=https://youtu.be/iJqSSHfLoWA] game's new teaser trailer [/url]revealed during IGN & Gamescom's 2020 "Awesome Indies" showcase.
- [url=twitter.com/CityofGangsters]Twitter[/url] & [url=www.facebook.com/CityofGangsters]Facebook[/url] pages where content will be shared daily at 7pm BST.
- A Discord server that you can all be members of [url=discord.gg/CityofGangsters]here. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625768/a73cb83fb0a56d933e50ae03e0a46a90844e2855.jpg[/img]

So make sure you keep your ear to the digital pavement & join us on the channels above to keep yourself updated on all things [i]City of Gangsters[/i]!
[/h3]
